chapter: Faith, study and the Chicago scene
title: Correcting the record on the Chicago Conservatory
summary: He only took private piano lessons there and never graduated.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: So if we could also look at the historical records, perhaps correct a few things that continually show up in your various biographies. Could you perhaps clarify your experience at the Chicago Conservatory of Music?

The Chicago Conservatory, I took private lessons there. It has been said that I graduated from there, somehow that got put down in my historical records. That is not the case, I did not graduate from there. I took some private lessons with some good
teachers there and proceeded on my own with various other people like Muhal Richard Abrams and listening.
So your studies there were exclusively piano? No theory, no drums?
No, no drums, nothing else, just piano only.
